signin.intro: With your email. No password: you get a link that works once. New here? Same form; your account is made when you first sign in.
lang.title: Language
lang.subtitle: The portal, your emails and Ali's replies come to you in this language. Ali and his agents read your messages in English.
lang.betaNote: Machine translation is weaker for this language. You can always open the original of a message.
lang.engine.deepseekNote: Best quality. Your messages are sent to DeepSeek's API, which runs in China, to be translated.
lang.engine.cloudflareNote: Your messages stay on Cloudflare, where the portal already runs. Lower quality, and a few languages are not available.
lang.engine.offNote: Nothing is sent to a translator. Write to Ali in English, and his replies stay in English.
